aarti.tek: The āratī of Śrī Gaiyā Maiyā, Mother Cow; the āratī of her who takes away sorrow, the nurse of the whole world.
aarti.pad1: Giver of wealth, of desires fulfilled and of true dharma, giver of the unshakeable, spotless state of liberation, maker of the good fortune of gods and men: this is the āratī of the beloved, revered cow of Nanda's son. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: Mother who sustains the whole world, giver of sweet, nectar-like milk and food, protector from disease, grief and trouble: this is the āratī of the sturdy boat for the ocean of worldly existence. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: She makes life, vigour and health flourish, destroys sorrow, wretchedness and poverty, and brings beauty, happiness and prosperity to light: this is the āratī of the giver of pure discernment and understanding. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: Be it a servant or one who causes pain, the Mother gives each alike her nectar-like milk to drink; she brings happiness to all, enemy and friend: this is the āratī of the mother of the world, whose nature is love. ॥4॥
